query: INSERT INTO imap_state_entries(link_id,kind,key,folder_id,message_id,sequence,received_at,document,body) SELECT $1,d.kind,d.key,d.folder_id,d.message_id,d.sequence,d.received_at,d.document,decode(d.body,'base64') FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS d(kind text,key text,folder_id text,message_id text,sequence bigint,received_at timestamptz,document jsonb,body text) ON CONFLICT(link_id,kind,key) DO UPDATE SET folder_id=EXCLUDED.folder_id,message_id=EXCLUDED.message_id,sequence=EXCLUDED.sequence,received_at=EXCLUDED.received_at,document=EXCLUDED.document,body=EXCLUDED.body
